notes: ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό is split because the ASV writes three English words (*in one place*), so rule 94's single-word precondition for a compound unit is not met; contrast ACT.2.44, where the same phrase collapses to *together*.
The articular infinitive follows rule 61: ἐν takes the bare clause-introducer *when* and τῷ is unrepresented.
